description: This PHP class file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for employee leave search filter parameters in the OrangeHRM system. It extends base filter parameters, includes traits, and defines properties and methods to set and get filtering criteria such as date ranges, employee number, leave statuses, and inclusion options.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for specifying search filters related to employee leave records, including date ranges, statuses, employee identifiers, and inclusion options, used within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of leave status codes set for filtering, or null if not set.

methods.name: setStatuses
methods.description: Sets the leave statuses for filtering after validating against allowed statuses and mapping through leave status association.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date for the leave search filter.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the leave search filter.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date for the leave search filter.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the leave search filter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number used in the filter.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves the inclusion mode for employee filtering.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion mode for employee filtering.
